text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-The 1997 budget draft law might not be approved by parliament until next year.
-Israeli forces killed two Arab guerrillas in a clash on the edge of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
-Schoolteachers suspended an indefinite strike planned for December 4.
-Unlicensed private television and radio stations did not shut down on November 30 as ordered to do earlier.
-Minister of Health Franjieh says there are 3,000 people infected with HIV virus.
-Christian Greek Orthozox Patriarch Hazim rejected proposed amendments to personal status law.
-Christian Maronite Patriarch Sfeir said: How can freedom survive in an imbalanced regime? There is no balance without freedom and no freedom without free political life.
